statement: Hardware shortages have forced Microsoft to turn away cloud and AI clients, restrict subscriptions and absorb service disruptions, with Temu shifting cloud operations to Oracle and an eight-hour GitHub outage in August 2026 tied to server constraints.
why: A hyperscaler refusing paying customers is direct evidence that deliverable compute, not customer appetite, is the binding limit right now.

impact.mechanism: Unserved cloud demand keeps GPU allocation tight and pushes overflow workloads to rival clouds and neoclouds while sustaining accelerator orders.

evidence.excerpt: Severe hardware constraints recently forced the tech giant to turn away cloud and AI clients, restrict subscriptions, and face service disruptions.

confidence.basis: Qualitative account in a single secondary republish of Bloomberg reporting; no lead-time or capacity figure attached.
